answer: One workable design: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because nadir only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. In practice gale is enforced by the ledger itself: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any vertex approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
